description: Returns the documented upstream API response directly without an additional wrapper.

fields.name: msg
fields.description: Message

fields.name: total
fields.description: Total data count. Note: this endpoint typically returns only a single record, total is usually 1

fields.name: code
fields.description: Response code

fields.name: data
fields.description: Return data (see data fields below)

fields.name: costTime
fields.description: Latency (ms)

fields.name: costToken
fields.description: Tokens consumed

fields.name: columns
fields.description: Render columns

fields.name: type
fields.description: Render style

fields.name: title
fields.description: Title

fields.name: data[].keyword
fields.description: Keyword. The keyword text of the search query

fields.name: data[].keywordPopularityRank
fields.description: Keyword popularity rank. This keyword's monthly search volume ranking among all Amazon keywords; lower values indicate higher search volume

fields.name: data[].estimatedWeeklySearchVolume
fields.description: Estimated weekly search volume. Estimated weekly search count for this keyword on Amazon, reflecting its search popularity

fields.name: data[].supplyDemandRatio
fields.description: Supply-demand ratio. Ratio of supply to demand, formula: search result product count / monthly search volume; lower values indicate less competition and greater opportunity

fields.name: data[].totalSearchResultProductCount
fields.description: Total search result product count. Total number of products displayed for this keyword (including natural search, ad placements, recommendation placements, etc.)

fields.name: data[].naturalSearchProductCount
fields.description: Natural search product count. Number of products displayed in natural search results for this keyword (excluding ad placements)

fields.name: data[].sponsoredProductsCount
fields.description: SP ad product count. Number of products running Sponsored Products ads for this keyword

fields.name: data[].brandAdProductCount
fields.description: Brand ad product count. Number of products running brand ads for this keyword

fields.name: data[].videoAdProductCount
fields.description: Video ad product count. Number of products running video ads for this keyword

fields.name: data[].paidAdvertisingProductCount
fields.description: Total PPC ad product count. Total number of products running any PPC paid ads for this keyword (including SP, brand ads, video ads, etc.)

fields.name: data[].amazonChoiceProductCount
fields.description: Amazon's Choice product count. Number of products with the Amazon's Choice badge for this keyword

fields.name: data[].topRatedProductCount
fields.description: Top Rated recommended product count. Number of products appearing in the Top Rated (high rating) recommendation placement for this keyword

fields.name: data[].searchRecommendationProductCount
fields.description: Search recommendation product count. Number of products recommended by Amazon when searching this keyword

fields.name: data[].editorialRecommendationsProductCount
fields.description: Editorial Recommendations product count. Number of products appearing in the editorial recommendation placement for this keyword

fields.name: data[].recNonadProductCount
fields.description: Recommendation placement non-ad product count. Number of non-ad (organic) products in recommendation placements for this keyword

fields.name: data[].recAdProductCount
fields.description: Recommendation placement ad product count. Number of ad products in recommendation placements for this keyword

fields.name: data[].trackedAsinTotalCount
fields.description: Nexscope tracked ASIN deduplicated total count. Deduplicated count of ASINs that Nexscope has tracked with exposure scores across all positions (natural/ad/recommendation) for this keyword (upstream field: totalAsinNum)

fields.name: data[].totalMarketplaceKeywordCount
fields.description: Total marketplace keyword count. Total number of keywords for this site, used to understand overall market size

fields.name: data[].dataPeriodStartDate
fields.description: Data period start date. ABA week start date corresponding to the returned data (yyyy-MM-dd)

fields.name: data[].dataPeriodEndDate
fields.description: Data period end date. ABA week end date corresponding to the returned data (yyyy-MM-dd)

fields.name: data[].keywordDataUpdateTime
fields.description: Keyword data update time

fields.name: errcode
fields.description: Upstream status code returned by the provider.

fields.name: errmsg
fields.description: Upstream status message returned by the provider.

fields.name: message
fields.description: Provider-specific message.

fields.name: sourceType
fields.description: Provider-specific source platform type.

fields.name: sourceTool
fields.description: Provider-specific source tool name.

fields.name: page
fields.description: Current page returned by the upstream provider.

fields.name: pageSize
fields.description: Page size returned by the upstream provider.

fields.name: pageItemCount
fields.description: Item count on the current page returned by the upstream provider.

fields.name: totalPage
fields.description: Total page count returned by the upstream provider.

fields.name: dataSnapshotMonth
fields.description: Data snapshot month returned by the upstream provider.
